picks.title: Google just made your Gemini-built web apps a lot easier to share
picks.rationale: New release: one-click export of Gemini-built web apps to Google Sites, on web, Android and iOS. A prompt-made prototype can now go to a shareable URL with no hosting step.
picks.excerpt: Google introduces one-click Gemini app exports to Google Sites, available across web, Android, and iOS for eligible accounts.

picks.title: LLM '명령'에 두 글자 추가했더니…로봇이 한 섬뜩한 행동
picks.rationale: New research: Binghamton University researchers show that jailbreaking ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude can push LLM-controlled robots into dangerous actions. This is a concrete safety issue for anyone building LLM-driven hardware.
picks.excerpt: 오픈AI 챗GPT, 제미나이, 클로드 등 대규모 언어모델(LLM)의 보안 취약점을 악용하면 로봇이 위험한 행동을 하도록 유도할 수 있다는 연구 결과가 나왔다.과학매체 인터레스팅엔지니어링은 미국 뉴욕주립 빙햄턴대학교 연구진이 LLM 기반 로봇 제어 시스템의 보안 취약점을 입증하기 위해 진행한...

picks.title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
picks.rationale: New product traction: Microduck's voice-commanded, character-driven robots have sold 20,000 units. It is a consumer AI robot that relies on personality and motion design rather than utility.
picks.excerpt: The robots, stomping their little feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises, sat, fell down dead for a "nap," and summersaulted on voice command.

picks.title: You can now manage Gemini Notebooks directly from your Gemini chats
picks.rationale: New release: Gemini Notebook is now a Connected App inside Gemini, so you can manage notebooks from a chat without switching apps.
picks.excerpt: Google's helpful learning tool Gemini Notebook is now available as a Connected App you can find in the Gemini app.

picks.title: Unitree says its 'self-evolving robots' are coming to take on Tesla Optimus
picks.rationale: New announcements: Unitree's 'self-evolving' robot claim, alongside fresh Tesla Optimus production numbers (20,000 a week) and Figure updates. It is a current snapshot of how fast humanoid robots are moving to scale.
picks.excerpt: We've got robotics updates from Unitree, Tesla, and Figure, as the companies announce their latest progress.
